```{r glm}
#Fitting GLM
library(MASS)
load("dat.RDATA")

dat$pt = dat$presence
dat$wt = ifelse(dat$presence == 1, 1e-6, dat$quad.size)
load("m.lgcp_lp.RDATA")
Z = as.matrix(get.bf.matrix(m.lgcp_lp, dat[, c("x", "y")]))
keep_cols = colSums(Z != 0) > 0 
Z_star = Z[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]

#sum(!keep_cols)
#sv = svd(Z)
#tol = max(dim(Z))*max(sv$d)*.Machine$double.eps #deciding when a singular value is effectively zero.
#r = sum(sv$d > tol) #number of singular values that are impactful
#V_r = sv$v[, seq_len(r), drop = FALSE] #keep r independent directions
#Z_star = Z%*%V_r #rotate original basis cols into r independent basis cols

X = cbind(1, dat$tempann, dat$rainann, dat$rugged, Z_star)

glm1 = glm.fit(y = dat$pt/dat$wt, x = X, intercept = FALSE, family = poisson(link = 'log'), weights = dat$wt)

#glm1 = glm(pt/wt ~ tempann + rainann + rugged + Z_reduced, family = poisson(link = 'log'), data = dat, weights = wt)

n = length(glm1$coefficients)
beta = glm1$coefficients[1:(n - ncol(Z_star))] 
u = glm1$coefficients[(n - ncol(Z_star) + 1):n]

new_X = cbind(1, dat$tempann, dat$rainann, dat$rugged)
#calculating loglikelihood
eta = new_X%*%beta + Z_star%*%u #10426 x 1, per-row linear predictor (fixed + spatial)
mu = exp(eta)

#weighted Poisson-process log-likelihood (DWPR/Berman-Turner approximation)
loglik_new_glm = sum(dat$pt * log(mu) - dat$wt *mu)
cat("loglik:", loglik_new, "\n")
  
#predict the fitted intensity at every grid cell
X_grid = model.matrix( ~tempann + rainann + rugged, data = grid_xy)
Z_grid = as.matrix(get.bf.matrix(m.lgcp_lp, grid_xy[, c("x", "y")])) #uses the bfs that m.lgcp_lp internally chose
Z_grid_star = Z_grid[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]

#Z_grid_star = Z_grid%*%V_r
grid_xy$z = exp(drop(X_grid%*%beta + Z_grid_star%*%u)) 

grid_pred_proj = st_sf(intensity = grid_xy$z,
                       log_intensity = log(grid_xy$z),
                       geometry = grid_cells_proj) #simple feature obj, dataframe containing spatial geometries
grid_pred_lonlat = st_transform(grid_pred_proj, target = 4326)

# Mapping according to vignette
load("po_sp_lonlat.RDATA")
load("intensity_map.RDATA")
glm_map = intensity_map(grid_pred_lonlat, title = "glm")
print(glm_map)

# Calculate the observed, simulated K functions
domain.grid = subset(grid_xy, select = -z)
# predict intensity values
domain.grid$z = grid_xy$z

# parameter values
var_u = 1 # var(u), inital u
vars <- rep(var_u, m.lgcp_lp$basis.per.res)
var_smooth_grid <- lambda^2 * drop(Z_grid_star^2 %*% vars)
var_smooth = mean(var_smooth_grid)
#var_smooth = var(drop(Z_grid%*%u)) #Z_grid_star
domain.grid$mu = drop(X_grid%*%beta)
fixed.im = as.im(domain.grid[, c("x", "y", "mu")], W = win)
# create  pixel images
pred.im = as.im(domain.grid[,c("x","y","z")], W = win)

# simulate the envelopes/bounds
load("po_sp_ppp.RDATA")
glm_K_obs <- Kinhom(po_sp_ppp, lambda = pred.im, correction = "border") #marginal.im
glm_K_env <- envelope(po_sp_ppp, fun = Kinhom, simulate = expression(rLGCP(model = "matern", mu = fixed.im, var = var_smooth, nu = 3/2, scale = m.lgcp_lp$basis.fn.info$scale[1])))

# Create Inhomogeneous K-func graphs
load("Kfunc.RDATA")
glm_kfunc = Kfunc(glm_K_obs, glm_K_env)
```

```{r glm with loop to convergence}
#Fitting GLM
library(MASS)
load("dat.RDATA")
dat$pt = dat$presence
dat$wt = ifelse(dat$presence == 1, 1e-6, dat$quad.size)
load("m.lgcp_lp.RDATA")
Z = as.matrix(get.bf.matrix(m.lgcp_lp, dat[, c("x", "y")]))
keep_cols = colSums(Z != 0) > 0 
Z_star = Z[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]

#Z_mean = Matrix::colMeans(Z_star)
#Z_ss = Matrix::colSums(Z_star^2)

#Z_sd = sqrt(
#  (Z_ss - n * Z_mean^2) / (n - 1)
#)

#Z_star = Z_star %*%
#  Matrix::Diagonal(x = 1 / Z_sd)

#initialise shared latent spatial field coefficients (u), one per basis function
u = rnorm(ncol(Z_star), 0, 1)

#attach Zu = each basis function's column scaled by u[k]
#(elementwise scaling via sweep - keeps all 50 basis functions SEPARATE, so column-update step can estimate full 49-length loading vector per species)
dat_rename = dat %>% 
  #mutate(Zu = sweep(Z_star, 2, u, "*"))
  mutate(Zu = Z_star%*%u)

X_full = cbind(1, dat_rename$tempann, dat_rename$rainann, dat_rename$rugged) #10426 x 4, fixed-effect design matrix
beta_lambda = matrix(NA,  nrow = 1, ncol = ncol(dat_rename$Zu) + ncol(X_full)) #fitted intercept+beta+lambda per species

N = 20 #max no. of outer (column-update + row-update) iterations
loglik = -Inf

for (iter in 1:N){
  # column update: for species, fit fixed effects + basis-function loadings (lambda)
  #design matrix - covariates + species' rows of spatial term (Zu)
  X = cbind(1, dat_rename$tempann,dat_rename$rainann, dat_rename$rugged, dat_rename$Zu)
  
  #weighted Poisson ridge regression - DWPR response (pt/wt), weight = wt
  glm1 = glm.fit(y = dat_rename$pt/dat_rename$wt, x = X, intercept = TRUE, family = poisson(link = 'log'), weights = dat_rename$wt, control = glm.control(maxit = 25)) #penalty.factor = penalty_factor)
  
  # store this species' intercept + beta (3 covariates) + lambda (43 loadings)
  beta_lambda = t(c(glm1$coefficients)) 
  
  #split fitted coefficients into fixed effects (beta) and basis-function loadings (lambda)
  beta_lambda
  beta = beta_lambda[, 1:ncol(X_full)] #54 x 4
  lambda = (beta_lambda[, (ncol(X_full) + 1):ncol(beta_lambda)]) #1 x 43
  
  #row update: fit one shared spatial field (u)
  #elementwise product: each basis function scaled by that row's species' loading
  X_joint = Z_star*lambda #10426 x 49

  #fixed-effect linear predictor
  offset_matrix = X_full%*%(beta) #10426 x 1
    
  #fit shared u via one joint ridge regression
  glm1 = glm.fit(x = X_joint, y = dat_rename$pt/dat_rename$wt, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), weights = dat_rename$wt, offset = as.numeric(offset_matrix), control = glm.control(maxit=25))
  
  new_u = as.numeric(glm1$coefficients)
    
  u = new_u #49 x 1, updated shared spatial field coefficients
  print(u)
  
  #rebuild Zu with updated u, for next iteration's column update
  #dat_rename$Zu = sweep(Z_star, 2, u, "*") #Z_star%*%u  #10426 x 49
  dat_rename$Zu = Z_star%*%u
  
  #convergence check - weighted Poisson-process log-likelihood kernel + Gaussian prior on u --- ##
  eta = offset_matrix + (Z_star * lambda) %*% u #10426 x 1, per-row linear predictor (fixed + spatial)
  mu = exp(eta)
  pred_glm = mu
  
  #weighted Poisson-process log-likelihood (DWPR/Berman-Turner approximation)
  loglik_new_glm = sum(dat_rename$pt * log(mu) - dat_rename$wt *mu)
  cat("iter", iter, "loglik:", loglik_new, "\n")
  
  #stop once relative change in log-likelihood is small
  if(abs((loglik_new_glm - loglik)/loglik_new_glm) < 1e-6) break
  loglik = loglik_new_glm}


#predict the fitted intensity at every grid cell
X_grid = model.matrix( ~tempann + rainann + rugged, data = grid_xy)
Z_grid = as.matrix(get.bf.matrix(m.lgcp_lp, grid_xy[, c("x", "y")])) #uses the bfs that m.lgcp_lp internally chose
Z_grid_star = Z_grid[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
Zu_grid = Z_grid_star%*%u

grid_xy$z = exp(drop(X_grid%*%beta + Zu_grid%*%lambda)) 

grid_pred_proj = st_sf(intensity = grid_xy$z,
                       log_intensity = log(grid_xy$z),
                       geometry = grid_cells_proj) #simple feature obj, dataframe containing spatial geometries
grid_pred_lonlat = st_transform(grid_pred_proj, target = 4326)

# Mapping according to vignette
load("po_sp_lonlat.RDATA")
load("intensity_map.RDATA")
glm_map = intensity_map_glmnet(grid_pred_lonlat, title = "glm")
print(glm_map)

# Calculate the observed, simulated K functions
domain.grid = subset(grid_xy, select = -z)
# predict intensity values
domain.grid$z = grid_xy$z

# parameter values
var_u = 1 # var(u), inital u
vars <- rep(var_u, m.lgcp_lp$basis.per.res)
var_smooth_grid <- drop((Z_grid_star * lambda)^2 %*% vars)
var_smooth = mean(var_smooth_grid)
#var_smooth = var(drop(Z_grid%*%u)) #Z_grid_star
domain.grid$mu = drop(X_grid%*%beta)
fixed.im = as.im(domain.grid[, c("x", "y", "mu")], W = win)
# create  pixel images
pred.im = as.im(domain.grid[,c("x","y","z")], W = win)

# simulate the envelopes/bounds
load("po_sp_ppp.RDATA")
glm_K_obs <- Kinhom(po_sp_ppp, lambda = pred.im, correction = "border") #marginal.im
glm_K_env <- envelope(po_sp_ppp, fun = Kinhom, simulate = expression(rLGCP(model = "matern", mu = fixed.im, var = var_smooth, nu = 3/2, scale = m.lgcp_lp$basis.fn.info$scale[1])))

# Create Inhomogeneous K-func graphs
load("Kfunc.RDATA")
glm_kfunc = Kfunc(glm_K_obs, glm_K_env)
```

```{r penalised glm}
#Fitting penalised glm

library(glmnet)
#penalty_factor <- c(
#  rep(0, 3),  # do not penalise fixed effects
#  rep(1, ncol(Z))   # penalise spatial coefficients
#)

load("dat.RDATA")
dat$pt = dat$presence
dat$wt = ifelse(dat$presence == 1, 1e-6, dat$quad.size)
load("m.lgcp_lp.RDATA")
Z = as.matrix(get.bf.matrix(m.lgcp_lp, dat[, c("x", "y")]))
keep_cols = colSums(Z != 0) > 0 
Z_star = Z[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]

glm1_reg = glmnet:::glmnet.fit(y = dat$pt/dat$wt, x = cbind(dat$tempann, dat$rainann, dat$rugged, Z_star), intercept = TRUE, family = poisson(link = 'log'), weights = dat$wt, alpha = 0, lambda = 1)#, penalty.factor = penalty_factor)

coefs = coefficients(glm1_reg)
n = length(coefs)
beta = coefs[1:(n - ncol(Z_star))]
u = coefs[(n - ncol(Z_star) + 1):n]

new_X = cbind(1, dat$tempann, dat$rainann, dat$rugged)
#calculating loglikelihood
eta = new_X%*%beta + Z_star%*%u #543323 x 1, per-row linear predictor (fixed + spatial)
mu = exp(eta)

#weighted Poisson-process log-likelihood (DWPR/Berman-Turner approximation)
loglik_new_glmnet = sum(dat$pt * log(mu) - dat$wt * mu)
cat("loglik:", loglik_new_glmnet, "\n")

#predict the fitted intensity at every grid cell
grid_xy$z = exp(drop(X_grid%*%beta + Z_grid_star%*%u))
#grid_xy$z = predict(glm1_reg, newx = grid_xy[, c("x", "y")], type = "response")

grid_pred_proj = st_sf(intensity = grid_xy$z,
                       log_intensity = log(grid_xy$z),
                       geometry = grid_cells_proj) #simple feature obj, dataframe containing spatial geometries
grid_pred_lonlat = st_transform(grid_pred_proj, target = 4326)

# Mapping according to vignette
load("po_sp_lonlat.RDATA")
load("intensity_map.RDATA")
glmnet_map = intensity_map(grid_pred_lonlat, title = "glmnet")
print(glmnet_map)

domain.grid = subset(grid_xy, select = -z)
# predict intensity values
domain.grid$z = grid_xy$z

# parameter values
var_u = 1/ridgePen
vars <- rep(var_u, m.lgcp_lp$basis.per.res)
var_smooth_grid <- drop((Z_grid_star * lambda)^2 %*% vars)
var_smooth = mean(var_smooth_grid)
#var_smooth = var(drop(Z_grid%*%u))

domain.grid$mu = drop(X_grid%*%beta)
fixed.im = as.im(domain.grid[, c("x", "y", "mu")], W = win)
# create  pixel images
pred.im = as.im(domain.grid[, c("x","y","z")], W = win)

# simulate the envelopes/bounds
load("po_sp_ppp.RDATA")
glmnet_K_obs <- Kinhom(po_sp_ppp, lambda = pred.im, correction = "border")
glmnet_K_env <- envelope(po_sp_ppp, fun = Kinhom, simulate = expression(rLGCP(model = "matern", mu = fixed.im, var = var_smooth, nu = 3/2, scale = m.lgcp_lp$basis.fn.info$scale[1])))

# Create Inhomogeneous K-func graphs
load("Kfunc.RDATA")
glmnet_kfunc = Kfunc(glmnet_K_obs, glmnet_K_env)

tmap_mode("plot")

load("gam_map.RDATA")
load("scampr_map.RDATA")
tmap_arrange(
  gam_map,
  scampr_map,
  glm_map,
  glmnet_map,
  nrow = 1
)

par(mfrow=c(1, 4))
Kfunc(gam_K_obs, gam_K_env)
Kfunc(scampr_K_obs, scampr_K_env)
Kfunc(glm_K_obs, glm_K_env)
Kfunc(glmnet_K_obs, glmnet_K_env)
```



```{r penalised glm with loop to convergence, Zulambda}
#Fitting penalised glm

library(glmnet)
#penalty_factor <- c(
#  rep(0, 3),  # do not penalise fixed effects
#  rep(1, ncol(Z))   # penalise spatial coefficients
#)

load("dat.RDATA")
dat$pt = dat$presence
dat$wt = ifelse(dat$presence == 1, 1e-6, dat$quad.size)
load("m.lgcp_lp.RDATA")
Z = as.matrix(get.bf.matrix(m.lgcp_lp, dat[, c("x", "y")]))
keep_cols = colSums(Z != 0) > 0 
Z_star = Z[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]

ridgePen=1 #penalty strength
nGlmnetIter=25 #max iterations glmnet allowed

#initialise shared latent spatial field coefficients (u), one per basis function
u = rnorm(ncol(Z_star), 0, 1)

#attach Zu = each basis function's column scaled by u[k]
#(elementwise scaling via sweep - keeps all 50 basis functions SEPARATE, so column-update step can estimate full 50-length loading vector per species)
dat_rename = dat %>% 
  #mutate(Zu = sweep(Z_star, 2, u, "*"))
  mutate(Zu = Z_star %*% u)

X_full = cbind(1, dat_rename$tempann, dat_rename$rainann, dat_rename$rugged) #10426 x 4, fixed-effect design matrix
beta_lambda = matrix(NA,  nrow = 1, ncol = ncol(dat_rename$Zu) + ncol(X_full)) #fitted intercept+beta+lambda per species

N = 20 #max no. of outer (column-update + row-update) iterations
loglik = -Inf

for (iter in 1:N){
    #design matrix - covariates + species' rows of spatial term (Zu)
    X = cbind(dat_rename$tempann, dat_rename$rainann, dat_rename$rugged, dat_rename$Zu)
    
    #weighted Poisson ridge regression - DWPR response (pt/wt), weight = wt
    glmnet1 = glmnet:::glmnet.fit(y = dat_rename$pt/dat_rename$wt, x = X, intercept = TRUE, family = poisson(link = 'log'), weights = dat_rename$wt, alpha = 0, lambda = ridgePen)#, maxit=nGlmnetIter) #penalty.factor = penalty_factor)
    
    # store this species' intercept + beta (3 covariates) + lambda (1 loading)
    beta_lambda = t(c(glmnet1$a0, as.numeric(glmnet1$beta))) 
  
  #split fitted coefficients into fixed effects (beta) and basis-function loadings (lambda)
  beta_lambda
  beta = beta_lambda[, 1:ncol(X_full)] #1 x 4
  lambda = (beta_lambda[, (ncol(X_full) + 1):ncol(beta_lambda)]) #1 x 1
  
    #row update: fit one shared spatial field (u)
  #elementwise product: each basis function scaled by that row's species' loading
  X_joint = Z_star * lambda #10426 x 1
  
  #fixed-effect linear predictor
  offset_matrix = X_full%*%beta #10426 x 1
    
  #fit shared u via one joint ridge regression
  glmnet1 = glmnet(x = X_joint, y = dat_rename$pt/dat_rename$wt, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), weights = dat_rename$wt, offset = as.numeric(offset_matrix), alpha = 0, lambda = ridgePen, standardize = FALSE)#, maxit=nGlmnetIter) 
  
  new_u = as.numeric(glmnet1$beta)
    
  u = new_u #43 x 1, updated shared spatial field coefficients
  print(u)
  
  #rebuild Zu with updated u, for next iteration's column update
  #dat_rename$Zu = sweep(Z_star, 2, u, "*") #Z_star%*%u  #543323 x 43
  dat_rename$Zu = Z_star%*%u
  
  #convergence check - weighted Poisson-process log-likelihood kernel + Gaussian prior on u --- ##
  eta = offset_matrix + (Z_star * lambda) %*% u #543323 x 1, per-row linear predictor (fixed + spatial)
  mu = exp(eta)
  pred_glmnet = mu

  #weighted Poisson-process log-likelihood (DWPR/Berman-Turner approximation)
  loglik_new_glmnet = sum(dat_rename$pt * log(mu) - dat_rename$wt * mu)
  cat("iter", iter, "loglik:", loglik_new_glmnet, "\n")
  
  #stop once relative change in log-likelihood is small
  if(abs((loglik_new_glmnet - loglik)/loglik_new_glmnet) < 1e-6) break
  loglik = loglik_new_glmnet}


#predict the fitted intensity at every grid cell
grid_xy$z = exp(drop(X_grid%*%beta + Zu_grid%*%lambda)) 
#grid_xy$z = predict(glm1_reg, newx = grid_xy[, c("x", "y")], type = "response")

grid_pred_proj = st_sf(intensity = grid_xy$z,
                       log_intensity = log(grid_xy$z),
                       geometry = grid_cells_proj) #simple feature obj, dataframe containing spatial geometries
grid_pred_lonlat = st_transform(grid_pred_proj, target = 4326)

# Mapping according to vignette
intensity_map_glmnet = function(grid_pred_lonlat, title){
  map <- tm_shape(border_lonlat) + # create tmap object
    tm_polygons() + # add border
    tm_shape(grid_pred_lonlat) + # create tmap object for points to overlay
    tm_polygons(fill = "log_intensity",
                fill.scale = tm_scale_continuous(
                  values = "turbo",
                  #limits =  c(-8, 0),
                  outliers.trunc = c(TRUE, TRUE)),
                col = NA,
                fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Log fitted intensity")) +
    tm_shape(po_sp_lonlat) +
    tm_dots(size = 0.2, fill = "red", shape = 4, fill_alpha = 0.8) + #, fill.legend = tm_legend_hide()) + # add the points
    tm_compass(type = "8star", position = c("left", "top")) + # add north arrow
    tm_title(title) + # manage the layout
    tm_grid(lwd = 0.2, labels.inside.frame = FALSE, alpha = 0.4, crs = 4326, # add the grid
            labels.format = list(big.mark = ",", fun = function(x){paste0(x, "º")}))
}  
load("po_sp_lonlat.RDATA")
glmnet_map = intensity_map_glmnet(grid_pred_lonlat, title = "glmnet")
print(glmnet_map)

domain.grid = subset(grid_xy, select = -z)
# predict intensity values
domain.grid$z = grid_xy$z

# parameter values
var_u = 1/ridgePen
vars <- rep(var_u, m.lgcp_lp$basis.per.res)
var_smooth_grid <- drop((Z_grid_star * lambda)^2 %*% vars)
var_smooth = mean(var_smooth_grid)
#var_smooth = var(drop(Z_grid%*%u))

domain.grid$mu = drop(X_grid%*%beta)
fixed.im = as.im(domain.grid[, c("x", "y", "mu")], W = win)
# create  pixel images
pred.im = as.im(domain.grid[, c("x","y","z")], W = win)

# simulate the envelopes/bounds
load("po_sp_ppp.RDATA")
glmnet_K_obs <- Kinhom(po_sp_ppp, lambda = pred.im, correction = "border")
glmnet_K_env <- envelope(po_sp_ppp, fun = Kinhom, simulate = expression(rLGCP(model = "matern", mu = fixed.im, var = var_smooth, nu = 3/2, scale = m.lgcp_lp$basis.fn.info$scale[1])))

# Create Inhomogeneous K-func graphs
load("Kfunc.RDATA")
glmnet_kfunc = Kfunc(glmnet_K_obs, glmnet_K_env)

tmap_mode("plot")

load("gam_map.RDATA")
load("scampr_map.RDATA")
tmap_arrange(
  gam_map,
  scampr_map,
  glm1_map,
  glmnet_map,
  nrow = 1
)

par(mfrow=c(1, 4))
Kfunc(gam_K_obs, gam_K_env)
Kfunc(scampr_K_obs, scampr_K_env)
Kfunc(glm_K_obs, glm_K_env)
Kfunc(glmnet_K_obs, glmnet_K_env)

c(loglik_new_gam, loglik_new_scampr, loglik_new_glm, loglik_new_glmnet)
c(pred_gam, pred_scampr, pred_glm, pred_glmnet)
```
